subsystems.name: Personal context store
subsystems.role: the record of how this person has decided before — the raw material for any surrogate.
parts: indexed email, chat and document history

subsystems.name: Perception layer
subsystems.role: lets the agent follow what is happening in a live meeting.

subsystems.name: Decision model
subsystems.role: proposes the choice the person would most likely make, with reasoning.
parts: large language model with tool use
policy rules for what may be decided alone

subsystems.name: Action layer
subsystems.role: carries out agreed decisions in the outside world.

subsystems.name: Boundary and escalation logic
subsystems.role: decides when the agent must stop and ask.

subsystems.name: Identity and audit layer
subsystems.role: makes clear who decided what, and proves it later.

buildSteps.title: Agree the delegation charter
buildSteps.detail: With the individual, write down which decisions may be made alone, what spend or commitment limits apply, and which topics always escalate.

buildSteps.title: Collect the decision record
buildSteps.detail: Gather the person's emails, chat, documents and past meeting transcripts with explicit consent, then classify what is sensitive and what is off-limits.

buildSteps.title: Label past decisions
buildSteps.detail: For each historical case, record the situation, the choice made, the reasoning and the outcome, so the model has worked examples rather than raw text.

buildSteps.title: Tune the model
buildSteps.detail: Fine-tune or prompt-tune a language model on those examples so its proposals match the person's tone, risk appetite and typical trade-offs.

buildSteps.title: Ground it at meeting time
buildSteps.detail: During a meeting the agent retrieves the most relevant past cases, the current agenda and any live documents, so its proposal is based on this specific context rather than averages.

buildSteps.title: Constrain the outputs
buildSteps.detail: The model may only emit validated action calls — book, accept, decline, send, promise — each checked against the charter before anything executes.

buildSteps.title: Add escalation
buildSteps.detail: Anything below a confidence threshold, outside scope or involving an unusual counterparty is packaged into a short summary for one-tap human approval.

buildSteps.title: Run in shadow mode
buildSteps.detail: For weeks or months the agent proposes and the human confirms, while agreement rate and near-misses are measured to find where the model is wrong.

buildSteps.title: Widen authority gradually
buildSteps.detail: Only after measurable reliability does the agent act alone on narrow, reversible, low-stakes decisions, with every action logged and periodically reviewed.

prerequisites.tech: Large language models with reliable tool use
prerequisites.why: the agent has to turn intent into concrete, correctly formatted actions in other software.

prerequisites.tech: Real-time speech recognition with speaker separation
prerequisites.why: meetings are the main arena, and attributing statements to the right person matters for accuracy.
the surrogate is only as good as the personal history it can search.
calendar and email connectors are common, but deep, portable access across workplace tools is not.
there is no accepted way to measure whether an agent makes the right call for a person across months of decisions.
counterparties need to know an AI is participating, and liability for a bad decision is unsettled.

pathway.milestone: meeting transcription, summarisation and action-item capture are standard workplace tools
pathway.unlocks: reliable raw material for anything that follows.

pathway.milestone: voice agents that negotiate appointments and bookings by phone, demonstrated as early as 2018 and still limited to narrow tasks
pathway.unlocks: proof that automated conversation can complete real transactions.

pathway.milestone: shadow-mode surrogates that attend meetings, draft positions and act only with one-tap approval
pathway.unlocks: the data needed to trust wider delegation.

pathway.milestone: bounded autonomous authority over recurring, reversible decisions, with audit logs and disclosure norms
pathway.unlocks: genuine time savings and a market for agents that negotiate with each other.
